title: Non-reciprocal phase shift of a Ce:YIG-clad silicon slab (em_modes, analytic)
description:
Cross-section modes (em_modes, mode_analysis at 1.55 um) of a silicon slab on silica under a Ce:YIG cladding (library ce_yig) magnetised along x, across the guide in the chip plane: material gyration_x = 0.009 (eps_yz = j g_x, |g| from the Faraday rotation ~ -4500 deg/cm). Periodic x (4 cells), CPML along y, uniform 5 nm cells, subpixel smoothing on. The sweep steps the silicon thickness d_si from 220 to 400 nm in 20 nm steps (the interfaces stay on cell edges: the gyration takes the cell-centre material, it is not smoothed).
Each mode gets the first-order non-reciprocal phase shift delta_beta = beta_forward - beta_backward from its fields (mode_table column delta_beta, scalar output modes_delta_beta_<k>): only the quasi-TM mode (row 1, E along y, the one whose E_y and E_z overlap in the magnetised cladding) shifts; TE0 (row 0) gives 0.
Analytic: the TM0 dispersion of the asymmetric slab, kappa d = atan(p_s) + atan(p_c), solved by 8 Newton steps in the parameters; with the gyration the cladding boundary term gains -+ beta g in the two directions (the exact gyrotropic slab), so to first order delta_beta = -g_x 2 eps_si / (eps_yig^2 (1 + p_c^2) F'(kappa)) (Mizumoto / Shintaku form). L_pi = pi / |delta_beta|: ~0.44 mm at 220 nm, ~1.8 mm at 400 nm, the scale of integrated Ce:YIG isolators.
Sweep tab: delta_beta_TM0 and n_eff_TM0 vs d_si with the dashed closed forms (the Ce:YIG loss, ~40 dB/cm, is in the run but not in the closed form: negligible here). Derived values tab (last value, 400 nm): delta_beta and L_pi with reference and relative error; the TE0 shift (0).

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the mode solve

parameters.name: eps_si
parameters.description: silicon core permittivity (library silicon, n = 3.476)

parameters.name: eps_sio2
parameters.description: silica substrate permittivity (library silica, n = 1.444)

parameters.name: eps_yig
parameters.description: Ce:YIG cladding permittivity (library ce_yig, n = 2.22; its small loss is left out of the closed form)

parameters.name: g_x
parameters.description: gyration of the Ce:YIG cladding, magnetised along +x (across the guide, in the chip plane)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: d_si
parameters.description: silicon thickness (swept 220-400 nm in 20 nm steps: the interfaces stay on cell edges; below ~210 nm TM0 nears the Ce:YIG light line)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: domain height (CPML beyond)

parameters.name: y_core
parameters.description: core centre line (a cell edge)

parameters.name: kv
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber

parameters.name: Vs
parameters.description: kappa^2 + gamma_s^2 (substrate side)

parameters.name: Vc
parameters.description: kappa^2 + gamma_c^2 (cladding side, the smaller)

parameters.name: kap0
parameters.description: TM0 start value of the core wavenumber kappa (just below the cladding cutoff)

parameters.name: kap1
parameters.expression: min(kap0 - (kap0*d_si - atan(eps_si/eps_sio2*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap0**2)/kap0) - atan(eps_si/eps_yig*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap0**2)/kap0))/(d_si + eps_si/eps_sio2*Vs**2/((kap0**2 + (eps_si/eps_sio2)**2*(Vs**2 - kap0**2))*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap0**2)) + eps_si/eps_yig*Vc**2/((kap0**2 + (eps_si/eps_yig)**2*(Vc**2 - kap0**2))*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap0**2))), 0.999*Vc)
parameters.description: Newton step 1 on F(kappa) = kappa d - atan(p_s) - atan(p_c) = 0, p_l = (eps_si / eps_l) gamma_l / kappa (TM0 of the unmagnetised slab)

parameters.name: kap2
parameters.expression: min(kap1 - (kap1*d_si - atan(eps_si/eps_sio2*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap1**2)/kap1) - atan(eps_si/eps_yig*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap1**2)/kap1))/(d_si + eps_si/eps_sio2*Vs**2/((kap1**2 + (eps_si/eps_sio2)**2*(Vs**2 - kap1**2))*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap1**2)) + eps_si/eps_yig*Vc**2/((kap1**2 + (eps_si/eps_yig)**2*(Vc**2 - kap1**2))*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap1**2))), 0.999*Vc)
parameters.description: Newton step 2 on F(kappa) = kappa d - atan(p_s) - atan(p_c) = 0, p_l = (eps_si / eps_l) gamma_l / kappa (TM0 of the unmagnetised slab)

parameters.name: kap3
parameters.expression: min(kap2 - (kap2*d_si - atan(eps_si/eps_sio2*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap2**2)/kap2) - atan(eps_si/eps_yig*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap2**2)/kap2))/(d_si + eps_si/eps_sio2*Vs**2/((kap2**2 + (eps_si/eps_sio2)**2*(Vs**2 - kap2**2))*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap2**2)) + eps_si/eps_yig*Vc**2/((kap2**2 + (eps_si/eps_yig)**2*(Vc**2 - kap2**2))*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap2**2))), 0.999*Vc)
parameters.description: Newton step 3 on F(kappa) = kappa d - atan(p_s) - atan(p_c) = 0, p_l = (eps_si / eps_l) gamma_l / kappa (TM0 of the unmagnetised slab)

parameters.name: kap4
parameters.expression: min(kap3 - (kap3*d_si - atan(eps_si/eps_sio2*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap3**2)/kap3) - atan(eps_si/eps_yig*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap3**2)/kap3))/(d_si + eps_si/eps_sio2*Vs**2/((kap3**2 + (eps_si/eps_sio2)**2*(Vs**2 - kap3**2))*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap3**2)) + eps_si/eps_yig*Vc**2/((kap3**2 + (eps_si/eps_yig)**2*(Vc**2 - kap3**2))*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap3**2))), 0.999*Vc)
parameters.description: Newton step 4 on F(kappa) = kappa d - atan(p_s) - atan(p_c) = 0, p_l = (eps_si / eps_l) gamma_l / kappa (TM0 of the unmagnetised slab)

parameters.name: kap5
parameters.expression: min(kap4 - (kap4*d_si - atan(eps_si/eps_sio2*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap4**2)/kap4) - atan(eps_si/eps_yig*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap4**2)/kap4))/(d_si + eps_si/eps_sio2*Vs**2/((kap4**2 + (eps_si/eps_sio2)**2*(Vs**2 - kap4**2))*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap4**2)) + eps_si/eps_yig*Vc**2/((kap4**2 + (eps_si/eps_yig)**2*(Vc**2 - kap4**2))*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap4**2))), 0.999*Vc)
parameters.description: Newton step 5 on F(kappa) = kappa d - atan(p_s) - atan(p_c) = 0, p_l = (eps_si / eps_l) gamma_l / kappa (TM0 of the unmagnetised slab)

parameters.name: kap6
parameters.expression: min(kap5 - (kap5*d_si - atan(eps_si/eps_sio2*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap5**2)/kap5) - atan(eps_si/eps_yig*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap5**2)/kap5))/(d_si + eps_si/eps_sio2*Vs**2/((kap5**2 + (eps_si/eps_sio2)**2*(Vs**2 - kap5**2))*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap5**2)) + eps_si/eps_yig*Vc**2/((kap5**2 + (eps_si/eps_yig)**2*(Vc**2 - kap5**2))*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap5**2))), 0.999*Vc)
parameters.description: Newton step 6 on F(kappa) = kappa d - atan(p_s) - atan(p_c) = 0, p_l = (eps_si / eps_l) gamma_l / kappa (TM0 of the unmagnetised slab)

parameters.name: kap7
parameters.expression: min(kap6 - (kap6*d_si - atan(eps_si/eps_sio2*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap6**2)/kap6) - atan(eps_si/eps_yig*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap6**2)/kap6))/(d_si + eps_si/eps_sio2*Vs**2/((kap6**2 + (eps_si/eps_sio2)**2*(Vs**2 - kap6**2))*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap6**2)) + eps_si/eps_yig*Vc**2/((kap6**2 + (eps_si/eps_yig)**2*(Vc**2 - kap6**2))*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap6**2))), 0.999*Vc)
parameters.description: Newton step 7 on F(kappa) = kappa d - atan(p_s) - atan(p_c) = 0, p_l = (eps_si / eps_l) gamma_l / kappa (TM0 of the unmagnetised slab)

parameters.name: kap8
parameters.expression: min(kap7 - (kap7*d_si - atan(eps_si/eps_sio2*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap7**2)/kap7) - atan(eps_si/eps_yig*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap7**2)/kap7))/(d_si + eps_si/eps_sio2*Vs**2/((kap7**2 + (eps_si/eps_sio2)**2*(Vs**2 - kap7**2))*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap7**2)) + eps_si/eps_yig*Vc**2/((kap7**2 + (eps_si/eps_yig)**2*(Vc**2 - kap7**2))*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap7**2))), 0.999*Vc)
parameters.description: Newton step 8 on F(kappa) = kappa d - atan(p_s) - atan(p_c) = 0, p_l = (eps_si / eps_l) gamma_l / kappa (TM0 of the unmagnetised slab)

parameters.name: neff_tm
parameters.description: analytic n_eff of TM0 (E along y, unmagnetised)

parameters.name: pc
parameters.description: p_c at the root

parameters.name: Fp8
parameters.expression: (d_si + eps_si/eps_sio2*Vs**2/((kap8**2 + (eps_si/eps_sio2)**2*(Vs**2 - kap8**2))*sqrt(Vs**2 - kap8**2)) + eps_si/eps_yig*Vc**2/((kap8**2 + (eps_si/eps_yig)**2*(Vc**2 - kap8**2))*sqrt(Vc**2 - kap8**2)))
parameters.description: F'(kappa) at the root

parameters.name: dbeta_ref
parameters.description: first-order beta_forward - beta_backward of TM0 [rad/m]: the gyration enters the cladding boundary term of the dispersion as -+ beta g_z (g_z = -g_x, the in-plane frame), d beta / d g_z = 2 eps_si / (eps_yig^2 (1 + p_c^2) F'(kappa)) per direction

parameters.name: Lpi_ref
parameters.description: length of a pi non-reciprocal phase difference [m]
